[Description] - This Program support windows 98 ~ 7 - This program usage is for lock directory by give type to directory - Newly, before ver 3.1 release i discover old program "Fake Folder" worked on this matter, Just want to thanks the writer.
[Warning] - Don't uses this program about system directory
[Change Log] ---Ver 3.1--- - Change some UI function - Change and improve Background function - Use Image file instead of program Resource
---Ver 3.0--- - Some Small Fixes - Change UI panel - Add ability to remain 10 paths
---Ver 2.2--- - Change UI panel - Add ability allow you to keep last path - Ability to set Background Skin in several size mode - More UI function, for easy usage - Setup project added , for install and copy some program font on your system
---Ver 2.1--- - Fixed some bug in unload folder - Added Button to open Folder fast from program
---Ver 2.0--- - " . " (Dot) Problem Fixed!!! Now you can use many Dot in your folder name - Fixed find manual type code(when you give a type to your folder manual) - More security, now you can set password for yourself - Added security question for lock ,unlocked folder in close program - Theme ability added - More UI function, for easy usage
